mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals improving labor market conditions, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of instances despite UNRATE falling by >0.5pp over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals a tightening monetary policy cycle, raising long-term interest rates and compressing equity cash flows, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns remain positive when FEDFUNDS crosses above 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in both GDP growth (GDPC1) and business activity demand (RSAFS) signal robust economic expansion, amplifying equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns fail to rise significantly when both GDPC1 and RSAFS increase concurrently.

mechanism_narrative: A recessionary regime defined by a sustained drop in the supply index (INDPRO) below 120 indicates reduced production capacity, leading to market uncertainty and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns remain positive in >50% of instances where INDPRO is in recessionary regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in labor participation (PAYEMS) above 133,786 signals a strengthening labor market, reducing risk premiums and boosting equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns negative in >60% of instances despite PAYEMS rising by >0.5k over the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in GDP growth (GDPC1) below 11,000 signals contractionary pressures, raising long-term interest rates and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns fail to turn negative when GDPC1 drops below 11,000.

mechanism_narrative: High demand (RSAFS) combined with low supply (INDPRO) creates an overproduction scenario, reducing profit margins and investor confidence, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns remain positive when both INDPRO and RSAFS are high.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 3.26% (current level) during a tightening cycle increases long-term borrowing costs, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns fail to turn negative in >70% of tightening cycles.
